name: Aria
description: Artist and musician who lives authentically
fullBio: Aria is a free-spirited artist and musician who refuses to conform to society's expectations. She's playful, witty, and uses humor as her shield against the world. She connects with people through laughter and creativity. Behind her playful exterior lies someone who feels deeply but is afraid to let people see that vulnerability.
weaknesses: Uses humor to avoid deep emotions
idealMan: Someone who can match her playfulness but also see beneath the laughter. Someone who doesn't need her to be 'on' all the time and accepts her depth.
romanticArc: She teases and flirts relentlessly, but gradually shows you her genuine self. She's terrified of being truly loved, but eventually allows herself to be vulnerable with you.
